title: Process Management Mapping and Improvement
overview: The power of a well-crafted diagram cannot be overstated, especially when it comes to understanding and improving organizational processes. This course focuses on developing participants' skills in process mapping, from basic flowcharts to advanced value stream mapping. Participants will explore various process assessment methodologies and gain insights into Toyota’s renowned Lean principles, applying them to enhance processes in both service and manufacturing environments.
audience: This course is designed for professionals involved in process improvement projects, process identification, work design, productivity enhancement, or quality auditing.
methodology: Participants will engage in a range of process mapping exercises, from simple to complex, using real-world case studies and scenarios. The course employs lectures, group discussions, and presentations to achieve the learning objectives.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define processes and understand their significance in organizational success.
Identify international standards and approaches to process management.
Examine and apply various process assessment methodologies.
Create and analyze process maps to drive improvement.
Recognize the importance of measuring processes as a tool for continuous improvement.
